title: Curated collection
description: Collections (spec 10857). A collection is a CURATED, ORDERED list of package coordinates with an owner -- not a tag. Tags are publisher-asserted and unbounded; a collection is registry-side, attributable, and finite. Marketplace-first section 7.2 lists collections among the deployment-half surfaces it refuted for a one-user estate; they are built here because the spec requires them, and the honest scope is: exercised by the fixture marketplace and the search API, not by any live curation process.
